prompt:
Subject: Faint profile in dappled sunlight

Main: A close-up portrait of a woman in her 20s looking at the camera over her shoulder in warm dappled sunlight. The face is positioned prominently from the center to slightly right, with light brown hair, amber eyes, and thin white shoulder straps as the main features.

Person/Expression: A clean oval face, large horizontal amber eyes, soft parallel eyebrows, a thin straight nose, and glossy pale rose lips. The body is turned to the left of the screen while the face is turned toward the camera, making direct eye contact with a calm, transparent expression and a slightly open mouth. Light ash-brown hair down to the collarbone, thin translucent long bangs, tucked behind the left ear, with thin wavy strands falling over the shoulder. Small silver ring and single stud earrings in the left ear.

Clothing/Pose: A white delicate lace sleeveless top. Only the thin shoulder strap is visible on the left shoulder, with the chest area cut off at the bottom. A very thin pale gold chain with a small vertical pendant around the neck. The upper body is angled with the shoulder brought forward, both arms and hands naturally down and out of frame.

Background/Lighting: Vertical wooden pillars and warm-colored buildings in the left background, blue-gray window panes and dark green plants in the far right background, blurred until shapes dissolve. Warm afternoon direct sunlight comes from the upper left, creating bright highlights on the bangs, forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, and shoulders. Soft shadows filtered through leaves are left on the left side of the face, with golden backlighting added to the hair outline.

Composition/Camera: 3:4 aspect ratio. A shoulder-to-chest close-up shot with a medium telephoto camera at eye level. Top of the head near the upper edge, face positioned large in the center-right, capturing the left ear and shoulder to the right side of the hair. Hair on the right and chest are cut off by the edges. Sharp focus on both eyes, with background and hair ends significantly blurred due to a very shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style: A photorealistic live-action photograph taken in outdoor natural light. High-definition rendering of fine skin texture and subtle gloss, clear catchlights in the eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, transmitted light through individual strands of bangs, fresh lips, and small reflections on metal accessories. A clean, natural color tone combining warm skin and hair tones with subtle blue and green in the background.

Negative: Change to short black hair, symmetrical frontal composition.

promptZh:
主体：
斑驳阳光下的柔和侧影

主要主体：
一位 20 多岁的女性在温暖斑驳的阳光下回眸看向镜头的特写肖像。她的脸部位于画面中心偏右的显著位置，突出了她的 亮棕色头发、琥珀色眼睛 以及细细的白色肩带。

人物与表情：
干净的椭圆形小脸，横向宽大的琥珀色双眼，柔和的平行眉，纤细挺直的鼻梁，以及富有光泽的淡玫瑰色嘴唇。她的身体朝向画面左侧，转头看向镜头，眼神平静而通透，嘴唇微张，与镜头进行直接的眼神交流。亮灰棕色的头发垂至锁骨，留着轻薄的长刘海，几缕细发别在左耳后，向肩部自然垂落。左耳佩戴着一枚小巧的银戒指和一颗单石耳钉。

服装与姿势：
白色精致蕾丝无袖上衣。左肩仅露出细细的肩带，领口位于画面下边缘之外。颈部佩戴一条极细的淡金色项链，挂着一个小巧的垂直吊坠。上半身微微倾斜以使肩膀前倾，双臂和双手自然下垂，处于画面之外。

背景与光影：
左侧是垂直的木柱和暖色调建筑，右后方是蓝灰色的窗面和深绿色叶片，背景经过虚化处理，形状模糊。温暖的午后直射阳光从画面左上方射入，在她的刘海、额头、鼻梁、脸颊和肩膀上形成明亮的高光。透过树叶过滤的柔和阴影投射在她脸部的左侧，为发际轮廓增添了一抹金色的背光。

构图与摄影：
垂直 3:4 比例。使用中长焦镜头在平视角度拍摄的从肩部上方到胸部上方的特写镜头。头顶靠近画面上边缘，脸部较大且位于画面中心偏右位置，捕捉了左耳和肩膀以及右侧头发的细节。右侧头发和胸部在画面边缘和下边界处被裁切。焦点清晰地对准双眼，极浅的景深使背景和发梢呈现出浓郁而柔和的虚化效果。

质感与风格：
在户外自然光下拍摄的写实照片。高清晰度渲染出细腻的皮肤纹理和适度的光泽感，眼睛里有清晰的眼神光，睫毛、眉毛、穿透每一缕刘海的透射光、嘴唇的鲜活感以及金属配饰上的微小反光均清晰可见。干净自然的色调，温暖的肤色和发色与背景的蓝色和绿色微妙地融合在一起。

负面提示词：
改为短黑发，正面对称构图。
